title: Ways to Visit the Museum | David J. Sencer CDC Museum | CDC
content: The David J. Sencer CDC Museum is temporarily closed. Continue to check our website for further updates on when we will reopen. When the museum reopens, all visitors will need to make reservations at least a week in advance. Walk-in visits are no longer permitted. Ways to Visit the Museum Print Minus Related Pages Important General information: All visitors and groups must have a reservation to come to the museum. Bring confirmation email(s) for museum visit. Visitors aged 18 and older must show a valid (not expired) government-issued REAL ID Non-U.S. citizens aged 18 and older must present a valid (not expired) passport. Cars and buses will be searched. You must exit the vehicle during the search. All weapons are prohibited, including mace and pepper spray. With the exception of necessary medical equipment or diaper bags, all large bags, backpacks, and bags or purses larger than 13 x 13 inches cannot be brought into the museum. All small purses or bags will be searched and scanned by CDC security. Timed-entry reservations and parking are free. One adult chaperone is required for every 10 visitors under age 18. Reservations are available 90 days in advance. Visits must be scheduled at least two weeks in advance for large groups and a week in advance for groups smaller than 10. The museum does not have a gift shop or place to purchase food.
